description: Starkregengefahrenkarte Düsseldorf is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. This dataset contains the maximum water level after a block rain 90mm / 60min. (SRI8) and the flow directions after a heavy rain in Düsseldorf. Only the critical flow velocities (flow pressure =0.175 m²/s) are shown. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Heavy rain hazard map Düsseldorf" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Düsseldorf, Gefahr, Wasserstand, Blockregen, Starkregen, Regen. The listing shows 2023-03-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
